title: Optional desktop camera
caption: Settings → Controls now offers a desktop third-person view with mouse look and camera-relative movement. Overview remains the default and the phone camera.

sections.title: Exploration
sections.caption: Click Mouse look, move with WASD and hold Shift to run. Escape releases the mouse.

sections.title: Inside the buildings
sections.caption: The free camera stays below physical ceilings and outside walls. Overview and dialogue keep their original cutaways.

sections.title: Dialogue and phone
sections.caption: Authored scenes keep their own camera. Phone play keeps the overview and touch controls.
